run_laikago_static_gait_example: run the Laikago robot walking forward simulation using a static gait controller for up to 10000 steps
run_run_example: run the Laikago static gait example with a configurable maximum number of simulation steps
load_config_gin: load the GIN configuration file for the Laikago walk static gait and bind rendering parameters
create_static_gait_controller: create a StaticGaitController policy instance using the Laikago robot environment for action generation
load_env_loader: load the Laikago simulation environment using env_loader and reset with a fixed random seed
